visual_identity.core_identity: A dominant goblin leader: still small and wiry, but better equipped, more self-important, and visibly in command.
visual_identity.silhouette: Small goblinoid body with oversized pointed ears, broader stance, raised chin, and commanding gesture.
visual_identity.head_features: Large pointed ears, short nose, angular face, wide mouth with small sharp teeth, heavy expressive brows.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact agile humanoid, slightly sturdier than a common goblin but never human-sized or orc-bulky.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly smooth skin with a few scars or wrinkles kept simple for coloring.
signature_gear: bent sword or decorated crude blade

accuracy_checks: clearly reads as goblin first and boss second
rank is shown through pose and scavenged gear
scene leaves broad areas to color

reference.notes: Reference defines goblin identity and proportions, not a composition to copy.
